rules.name: Maternity Benefit for Registered Women Construction Workers (Karnataka BOCW Welfare Board)

rules.message: Must be a construction worker registered with the Karnataka Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
Only for the first two deliveries; not available if she already has two living children

benefits.text: ₹50,000 per delivery (for a male or female child), for the first two deliveries only.

required_documents.name: Proof of identity / Board smart card (attested)
Birth certificate of the child, or delivery certificate from a hospital in Karnataka signed by the doctor
Discharge summary and photo of the child
For a second delivery: affidavit stating the claim is for the second delivery

how_to_apply.text: Submit the application to the Board; it is verified by a Senior/Labour Inspector and approved by the Labour Officer.

evidence.quote: on an application from a registered woman construction worker sanction Rs.50,000/-[for a Male/Female child], only for first two deliveries

evidence.claim: Not if two living children; second-claim affidavit
evidence.quote: The registered woman construction worker shall not be given this assistance if she already has two living children.
certificate of delivery in a government or private hospital in the state of Karnataka duly signed by the doctor concerned

flags.detail: A Labour Department listing seen in search results gave older amounts (Rs 30,000 for a girl, Rs 20,000 for a boy). That page could not be retrieved (domain did not resolve). The Board's own page says Rs 50,000; reviewer should confirm the current notification.

notes: Registration with the Board is not asked in the questionnaire, so it is a manual check; the occupation answer is not used because the registration, not the answer, decides eligibility.
